decision_cruda.rationale: E569-08 stopped, so LH-03 is idle. Activate RS-N548-03 (18.4 g/t, 311 t) at Norte. Norte's stockpile is nearly empty (22/450 t) and its trucks (66 t/h) exceed the current inflow (29 t/h), so the ore all counts. Travel is 0.72 h plus 1 h activation, leaving about 5 h of loading at 38.5 t/h, roughly 190 t or about 110 oz. Central reserves are lower grade, and Central is truck-limited (inflow 159 t/h vs 91 t/h trucks). No loaders are down, so no loans are needed.
